runtime_status: runtime-evidenced on Windows PowerShell 5.1: every MCP server in three live provider configs completed a real initialize -> tools/list exchange, and the three dead command paths found there were repaired and re-verified. Linux/static/artifact gates pass in CI.
notes: v7.9.8.5: point release. codebase-memory skill (canonical + 10 provider copies) gained the production evidence from maintaining a live cbm 0.10.8 install on Windows: upstream issue #1663 (web UI tiles show zero because the RPC allowlist rejects get_graph_schema since 0.10.5 while /api/project-health serves correct numbers; maintainer-confirmed as a deterministic UI regression, still open in 0.10.8) is documented with its working workaround shape -- a same-origin companion proxy serving real totals and per-project health, required because upstream rejects foreign-origin readers. The skill also records that auto-indexing was re-vetoed with proof (one MCP handshake from a scratch dir indexed %TEMP% within seconds) and that issue #1764's accepted root cause (10ms maintenance observers) FAILED an A/B repro: a geometric-backoff patch built from source showed no improvement over stock while idle, and the burn reproduced on only ~half of spawns as a single hot thread -- treat it as unsolved and unattributed. Gate change: .github/scripts/check_versions.py accepts three-or-more part versions ((?:[0-9]+\.)+[0-9]) so 4-part point releases pass CI; exact equality between VERSION.txt and every declaration is still enforced. No skills added or removed (146 canonical); no bundled tools changed.
